manifest_hash_scope: Capture during active preparation. Later timing_plan_sha256 augmentation changes manifest bytes legitimately; source, artifact and validation captures carry independent identities.

clean_measurement.publication_rule: Use only complete timing/measurement.json rows backed by the frozen timing plan, one passed warmup and all five passed samples; never parse workload clocks from validation logs.

compile_costs.interpretation: Separate contended one-attempt process costs, not clean execution samples or a quiet compilation benchmark.
limitations: SFIR build includes frontend and mandatory Binaryen optimization.
Native helper repeats mandatory optimization from retained raw Wasm before LLVM/linking; do not add it to SFIR build without labeling overlap.
Rust per-bin build records share a frozen Cargo target cache and are not clean independent from-scratch compilation costs.
Timeouts and failed builds retain status and command records; duration does not establish a successful compile.

final_report_sections: Frozen identity, source coverage and terminal campaign status
Clean artifact eligibility and native optimized-guest parity
Complete same-campaign clean medians and ratios
Separate build/process costs, artifact sizes and failures
Manifest, timing plan, measurements, commands and archive hashes
exclusions: Do not inherit validation or measurement status from manifest cases or corpus metadata.
Do not replace original Ack SFIR/Rust Wasm failures with worker or altered-tier diagnostics.
Do not combine these observations with historical six-case measurements or paired input-buffer experiments.
An absent adapted control is unavailable, not a passed route and not a missing execution result.
Per-case status captures and the completed-prefix report can advance between reads; this is explicitly a pending non-atomic snapshot.
A missing case-status file can coexist with a running initial SFIR build; it does not prove that work has not started.
route_availability_scope: Presence of source/control descriptions, not built artifacts or successful target execution.
